reason: User input from HTTP header flows through URL decoding, through doSomething() which preserves the value via HashMap round-trip, and directly concatenates into XPath expression at line 70. The XXE disallow-doctype-decl setting protects against DOCTYPE injection but does not sanitize XPath expression content - user-controlled data can still cause XPath injection.

evidence.note: user input flows to XPath expression without proper sanitization
